remote_mcp_server_list.description: SeaSight domain cognition MCP (platform-side read-only acceptance)

tools.name: knowledge_list_assets
tools.description: List registered domain assets with optional text and metadata filters.

tools.name: knowledge_asset_detail
tools.description: Read one asset and all immutable content versions.

tools.name: knowledge_list_ontology_versions
tools.description: List ontology versions and their review or publication status.

tools.name: knowledge_ontology_version_detail
tools.description: Read one ontology version.

tools.name: knowledge_list_ontology_nodes
tools.description: List ontology nodes and their human-review decisions.

tools.name: knowledge_list_ontology_relations
tools.description: List ontology relations and their evidence and review decisions.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Search assets with ontology-guided, cross-document multi-hop retrieval.

tools.name: knowledge_list_decisions
tools.description: List decision traces, optionally scoped to one agent run.

tools.name: knowledge_decision_evidence
tools.description: Read the ordered evidence chain for one decision trace.

tools.name: event_get
tools.description: Read one event, its status, category, evidence and coordinates.

tools.name: event_list

tools.description: List work orders with optional status or assigned-resource filters.

tools.name: task_ack_history

tools.name: dashboard_get
tools.description: Read the current governance dashboard metrics.

tools.description: Read one agent run, including pending approval identifiers.

tools.name: agent_run_steps
